summary: Correction to evt-20260812-105900-g43k9m2v-fidelity-no-new-gap: that mining conclusion was too broad because it screened retained Fidelity PRs/tests but failed to reconcile earlier same-day durable capacity-mining events and lane state. evidence: Earlier event evt-20260812-083100-x9c2p7r4n6-fidelity-config-closed-shape proves retained #419 validates recognized PolicyConfig fields but does not reject unknown keys; copyConfig() silently drops extras, including misspelled safety-budget overrides.

Earlier event evt-20260812-083120-w3n8q6v2-fidelity-policyinputs-closed-shape proves validateInputs() likewise accepts otherwise-valid runtime input records carrying unknown or misspelled keys and silently evaluates only recognized fields.

Live lane HG-FIDELITY-CONFIG-CLOSED-SHAPE is already PROPOSED at priority 5040, explicitly combines both defects, depends on HG-FIDELITY-MANAGER-STATE-ENCAPSULATION DONE, preserves the reviewed 65,536 registration ceiling, and forbids competing FidelityManager WIP before that dependency clears.

The separate dependency event evt-20260812-105100-q5m8v3n2-fidelity-capacity-lane-conflict also confirms newer Fidelity leaves are intentionally sequenced behind the retained capacity-ceiling lineage rather than cancelled.
No product source, tests, Studio evidence, or unlock state is changed by this correction; it only restores accurate durable scheduler guidance.
